depends_on.description: Resolved dependency relation between two releases.

registry_reports_signing_key.description: An ecosystem registry's metadata associates this artifact with this signing key. OBSERVATION ONLY: no cryptographic verification performed against artifact bytes. Policies requiring strong evidence MUST require `cryptographically_verified_signature_by`.

cryptographically_verified_signature_by.description: A signature over the artifact's bytes was fetched AND validated by this binary, in this run, against a known public key whose trust chain anchors to a pinned root (Fulcio public-good root for Sigstore). This is a VERIFICATION outcome, not a registry claim. Invariant 16: may only be emitted from locally executed verification — never inherited from upstream registry claims, federated peers, or third-party verifiers.

published_by.description: Identity recorded by the registry as publisher of a release.

published_at.description: Release timestamp as recorded by the registry.

affected_by.description: Artifact is affected by a vulnerability advisory.

attests_to.description: Attestation envelope refers to a subject.

revises.description: Supersession edge: this assertion replaces another. Meta-predicate.
